channel.title: Yat's List · 深圳外国人活动
channel.description: Shenzhen expat events — meetups, shows, nightlife, exhibitions, festivals and trade shows, gathered from multiple public sources, verified entry by entry and updated daily by Yat's List.

item.title: New Link: Anish Kapoor, Olafur Eliasson and the Future of Art — Shenzhen International Art Museum
item.description: Time: 2026-05-30T10:00:00+08:00 | Venue: Shenzhen International Art Museum | Kapoor, Eliasson and other big international names fill the new Shenzhen International Art Museum, with Xu Bing and an art-and-tech biennale on the other floors. ｜ Kapoor、Eliasson 等国际艺术大牌齐聚新开馆的深圳国际美术馆，其他楼层还有徐冰的展览与一场艺术与科技双年展。

item.title: Qian Lihuai: Weft Genesis — Bamboo Weaving at Sea World Culture & Arts Center
item.description: Time: 2026-08-22T10:00:00+08:00 | Venue: Design Society | More than 20 large bamboo-weaving works by a Wuzhen craftsman who has shown in Paris and Venice, ending in a dark room of nearly 100 lit bamboo spheres. ｜ 出自一位曾在巴黎、威尼斯展出的乌镇匠人之手的 20 多件大型竹编作品，结尾是一间陈列近 100 颗发光竹球的暗室。

item.title: Pan Yuliang: Lines of the Soul — MOCAPE
item.description: Time: 2026-08-25T10:00:00+08:00 | Venue: MOCAPE | A major survey of Pan Yuliang's oil paintings, ink, line drawing and prints, tracing a pioneering modern artist between China and Europe. ｜ 潘玉良油画、水墨、线描与版画大型回顾展，追溯这位先锋现代艺术家在中国与欧洲之间的艺术轨迹。

item.title: Butterflies of Lingnan: Macro Nature Photography
item.description: Time: 2026-08-29T10:00:00+08:00 | Venue: Shenzhen Art Museum (new building) | Hundreds of macro photographs reveal the butterflies, insects, flower structures and other tiny life of Shenzhen's hills and parks. ｜ 数百幅微距摄影作品，展现深圳山野与公园里的蝴蝶、昆虫、花朵结构等微小生命。

item.title: Yan Shanchun: Archaeology of Memory — MOCAPE
item.description: Time: 2026-09-01T10:00:00+08:00 | Venue: MOCAPE | A solo show for Yan Shanchun, the Shenzhen-based painter of quiet West Lake landscapes, at MOCAPE in Futian until 19 November. ｜ 以静谧西湖山水见长的深圳画家严善錞个展，在福田 MOCAPE 展出至 11 月 19 日。
